For optimal results, this medication should be used in conjunction with a doctor-approved exercise program and diet plan. 3. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if more than 1 to 2 hours have passed since your meal, skip the missed dose because most of the fat from your meal will already have been absorbed, rendering the medication ineffective. 4. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. 5. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 6. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. 9. Before taking orlistat, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. 10. If you are diabetic, weight loss may improve your blood sugar control. Regularly monitor your blood sugar levels and report the results to your doctor. 11. This medication must not be used during pregnancy. Weight loss offers no benefit to a pregnant woman and may harm an unborn baby. 12. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. 13. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. 14. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 15. If you are taking medications to treat seizures, orlistat may reduce their effectiveness. 16. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 17. Laboratory tests, such as kidney function tests, may be conducted while you are taking this medication. 18.
